item.title: Law enforcement block road near Nancy Guthrie’s home during investigation into her disappearance
item.description: Law enforcement investigating the disappearance of “Today” show host Savannah Guthrie’s mother have blocked off a road near Nancy Guthrie’s home in Arizona. A parade of sheriff’s and FBI vehicles, including forensics vehicles, passed through a roadblock Friday night about 2 miles from her house. The agencies also tagged and towed a Range Rover from a nearby Culver's restaurant parking lot. The Pima County Sheriff’s Department says the activity was part of the Guthrie investigation, but no arrest
